definitions.gloss: valuables; precious items; personal effects of value
definitions.explanation: Items of monetary or personal value such as wallets, jewelry, passports, and electronics. Commonly referenced in travel, security, and storage contexts.

examples.japanese: {貴重品|きちょうひん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧につけて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please keep your valuables on your person.

examples.japanese: {貴重品|きちょうひん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦フロント→フロント：01378_furonto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{預|あず}けられます→預ける：01819_azukeru⟧。
examples.english: Valuables can be left at the front desk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車内|しゃない}→車内：06203_shanai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{貴重品|きちょうひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}いた→置く：01092_oku⟧まま⟦{離|はな}れないで→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please do not leave valuables in the car when you step away.

notes:
USAGE:
A very common word seen on signs in hotels, locker rooms, pools, and public facilities. Frequently appears in safety warnings and travel advisories.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {貴重品|きちょうひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{預|あず}ける→預ける：01819_azukeru⟧ (to deposit valuables)
- {貴重品|きちょうひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧ (management of valuables)
- {貴重品|きちょうひん}⟦ロッカー→ロッカー：09734_rokkaa⟧ (valuables locker)
- {貴重品|きちょうひん}{入|い}れ (valuables case/pouch)

FORMS:
⟦{貴重|きちょう}→貴重：00223_kichou⟧ (precious, valuable) + ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (item, goods).
